Name: All For The Game Merch
Author: chocolatte12
Description:
This new merch pack brings merch from your favourite Exy teams to Pelican Town.

Buying the Exy Merch Catalogue from Pierre will give you access to exclusive merch from the Foxes, Ravens, and the Trojans!

Now you can deck out your house with merchandise to prove that you're the biggest fan. You can snuggle up with your team's mascot or hang up a pennant so everyone knows which team you're rooting for.

The catalogue offers pennants, rugs, plushies, and more designed after your team of choice! Many decorations come in two color variants, giving you choice in your decor. There are even unique wallpapers offered based on each team!

The jerseys on offer in the catalogue can be tailored in order to make your very own jersey! There are two jerseys per team, one regular and one goalie.
﻿*To make the raven goalie jersey use jersey #14. The rest of the goalie jerseys can be made with a goalie jersey from the respective team.

If you aren't an Exy fan some of the furniture is still cute! 

*Rugs in the pictures were moved using Precise Furniture, they're all 2x2 centered.
